QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] Parwen the Ghost
QuestInfo.0: When I entered a lab full of #o6110301#, I heard a strange voice somewhere inside #r#m261020401##k... this is not good.\r\n\r\n(You can move to #r#m261020401##k from #b#m261020400##k.)
QuestInfo.1: Following along the deep, mature voice, I found myself having crossed the #bstrange #o6110301##k.
QuestInfo.2: A strange #o6110301#... Apparently it's the alchemist that worked here before, called #p2111006#. What? Does that mean he's... a ghost! For a ghost, he certainly does not seem intimidating...

0.0: ...who's there? I can tell you're here. I don't know who you are, but please come help me...

1.0: Nice to meet you... I am #p2111006#, a researcher in this lab... Hmm... why are you looking at me like that? You look like you've just witnessed something horrific...
1.1: Anyway it's so good to encounter someone here. It's been a long time since I last talked to a person. I wonder what's wrong with the alchemists these days... they just never drop by the lab.
1.2: Why did I call you? Well... Hmm... I actually just called you because it was so good to see someone here. Hahahaha... there's actually nothing that I need from you. I just felt like talking for once... hahaha!
